$schema_note: Machine-readable snapshot of RhythmPrism's cross-service value stream. See VSM.md for the human-readable / diagram version. Snapshot date: 2026-07-15. Code is the source of truth; update this when routes or inter-service calls change.

rp-frontend.stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4
rp-frontend.role: SPA, single view-state machine in App.tsx (no router lib)
calls: rp-backend only, via /api and /sonolus (proxied by nginx / Vite VITE_PROXY_TARGET)

rp-backend.role: REST API for the web frontend (router/web) + Sonolus game-client protocol (router/sonolus). Owns all writes to DB and S3; orchestrates the 3 converter microservices.

auth.web: Discord OAuth2 -> httpOnly JWT cookies (access_token/refresh_token), utils/auth.py + utils/dependencies.py
auth.sonolus_client: sonolus_id lookup -> separate Sonolus session id, router/sonolus/authenticate.py
auth.linking: router/web/user/sonolus.py links a User's Discord account to a sonolus_id

background_jobs.scheduler: utils/scheduler.py, APScheduler BackgroundScheduler: flips Chart.status SCHEDULED -> PUBLIC at a future datetime
background_jobs.webhook: utils/webhook.py: send_new_chart_notice posts to Discord (DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL) as a BackgroundTask after first publish

rp-bgm-converter.role: Stateless audio converter, no storage/DB access

endpoint.input: multipart file (audio) + query params start_time (default 40s), preview_seconds (default 15s)
endpoint.output: zip(bgm.mp3 192k, preview.mp3 128k mono w/ loudnorm+fade) streamed as application/zip

rp-image-converter.role: Stateless image converter, no storage/DB access

endpoint.output: zip(jacket.png 500x500 letterboxed, bg.png composited from static templates in assets/original/) streamed as application/zip

rp-level-converter.role: Stateless chart-format converter, no storage/DB access

endpoint.input: raw request body, format auto-detected: gzip LevelData JSON | JSON w/ usc field | SUS text
endpoint.output: JSON { chartformat, leveldata } on success, HTTP 500 { error } on failure

object_storage_dev.bucket_setup: createbuckets one-shot container runs mc mb + mc anonymous set public

chart_publish: rp-frontend SubmitChart.tsx: user fills metadata + selects chart_file/bgm_file/jacket_file
rp-backend: SHA1 hash each converted artifact, build S3 keys
rp-backend: parallel upload all artifacts to S3 (asyncio.gather)
rp-backend: INSERT Chart + BackgroundItem rows, commit
rp-backend BackgroundTask: Discord webhook notice if published immediately
rp-backend APScheduler: if status=SCHEDULED, flip to PUBLIC at future datetime
chart_edit: rp-frontend EditChart.tsx: user replaces a subset of fields/files
PUT /api/chart?chart_id= (multipart, only changed fields) -> rp-backend edit_chart.py
only-changed files re-sent to the relevant converter(s)
upload new S3 objects, then delete superseded ones
BackgroundTask: Discord webhook only on first-ever publish
sonolus_client_read: Sonolus game client authenticates via router/sonolus/authenticate.py (sonolus_id lookup)
rp-backend reads Chart/BackgroundItem/etc rows from Postgres
rp-backend returns stored S3 public URLs directly (S3_HOST + key), no conversion at read time
auth_web: user clicks Discord login -> GET /api/discord/login redirect
Discord OAuth2 callback -> router/web/user/discord.py creates/updates User
auth_sonolus_link: logged-in web user links a Sonolus account via router/web/user/sonolus.py
sets User.sonolus_id, enabling router/sonolus/authenticate.py to recognize the client later
